title: Singular negative questions: Eikö tämä ole…?
focus: Build singular negative yes/no questions with eikö and ole.

exercises.prompt: Build “Isn't that key at home?” At a school entrance. Use the supplied phrase tuo avain (“that key”) and kotona (“at home”).
exercises.explanation: Eikö carries singular negative agreement and -ko/-kö; ole follows later in the question.
